references.text: The people also grumbled against Moses at Marah because of the bitter water, showing a pattern of complaining in the wilderness.
The people again grumbled against Moses at Rephidim due to lack of water; the same Hebrew root (לון) is used.
The whole congregation of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron; the same expression 'כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל' is used.
The whole congregation grumbled against Moses and Aaron during Korah's rebellion.
The Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron the day after Korah's judgment.
The psalmist refers to how the people grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the Lord's voice.
A complementary event showing the consequence of the complaint: the leader's humiliation.
Direct narrative continuation; shows God's response to the complaint.
A theological interpretation identifying the complaint as envy toward God's chosen ones.
A parallel conflict over leadership authority and the congregation's role.
